caption: The drawing depicts an old cannon mounted on a stone base. The cannon is metallic in appearance, mostly colored in dark brown tones with subtle highlights and shadows suggesting a worn surface. The cannon is positioned horizontally, extending from the left side of the stone base toward the right side of the image, with rings and structural details visible along its length. Attached to the cannon is a long, narrow wooden beam, colored light brown with visible grain texture; it lies across the top of the cannon, fastened by a metal ring. The stone base beneath the cannon is composed of irregular, grayish stones, with a round opening or hole in the front. The background is a plain, unadorned off-white color, and there are no other objects or elements present in the image. The artist’s signature is visible in small, fine script near the bottom right of the image.
title: Water Nozzle
